Consider the differential equation

$$
\frac{\text{d}y}{\text{d}x}=- \frac{2 y}{x} + \frac{x^{2} + y^{2}}{x y}.
$$

If the transformation $y=v(x)x$ is applied to the differential equation, what is the resulting equation?
question.:question/worked-solution:
Using the transformation $y=vx$ (where $v=v(x)$), we have

$$
\begin{aligned}\frac{\text{d}y}{\text{d}x} & =x\frac{\text{d}v}{\text{d}x}+v\frac{\text{d}}{\text{d}x}(x) \\  & =x\frac{\text{d}v}{\text{d}x}+v.\end{aligned}
$$

Substituting the above into the given differential equation, we get

$$
\begin{aligned}\frac{\text{d}y}{\text{d}x} & =- \frac{2 y}{x} + \frac{x^{2} + y^{2}}{x y} \\ x\frac{\text{d}v}{\text{d}x}+v & =- 2 v + \frac{v^{2} x^{2} + x^{2}}{v x^{2}} \\ x\frac{\text{d}v}{\text{d}x}+v & =- 2 v + \frac{v^{2} + 1}{v} \\ x\frac{\text{d}v}{\text{d}x} & =- 3 v + \frac{v^{2} + 1}{v} \\ x\frac{\text{d}v}{\text{d}x} & =\frac{1 - 2 v^{2}}{v} \\ \left(- \frac{v}{2 v^{2} - 1}\right)\frac{\text{d}v}{\text{d}x} & =\frac{1}{x}.\end{aligned}
$$

question.:question/problem:
Consider the differential equation

$$
\frac{\text{d}y}{\text{d}x}=\frac{2 x^{2} - x y + y^{2}}{x^{2} + y^{2}} - \frac{2 y}{x}.
$$

If the transformation $y=v(x)x$ is applied to the differential equation, what is the resulting equation?
question.:question/worked-solution:
Using the transformation $y=vx$ (where $v=v(x)$), we have

$$
\begin{aligned}\frac{\text{d}y}{\text{d}x} & =x\frac{\text{d}v}{\text{d}x}+v\frac{\text{d}}{\text{d}x}(x) \\  & =x\frac{\text{d}v}{\text{d}x}+v.\end{aligned}
$$

Substituting the above into the given differential equation, we get

$$
\begin{aligned}\frac{\text{d}y}{\text{d}x} & =\frac{2 x^{2} - x y + y^{2}}{x^{2} + y^{2}} - \frac{2 y}{x} \\ x\frac{\text{d}v}{\text{d}x}+v & =- 2 v + \frac{v^{2} x^{2} - v x^{2} + 2 x^{2}}{v^{2} x^{2} + x^{2}} \\ x\frac{\text{d}v}{\text{d}x}+v & =- 2 v + \frac{v^{2} - v + 2}{v^{2} + 1} \\ x\frac{\text{d}v}{\text{d}x} & =- 3 v + \frac{v^{2} - v + 2}{v^{2} + 1} \\ x\frac{\text{d}v}{\text{d}x} & =\frac{- 3 v^{3} + v^{2} - 4 v + 2}{v^{2} + 1} \\ \left(\frac{- v^{2} - 1}{3 v^{3} - v^{2} + 4 v - 2}\right)\frac{\text{d}v}{\text{d}x} & =\frac{1}{x}.\end{aligned}
$$

question.:question/problem:
Consider the differential equation

$$
\frac{\text{d}y}{\text{d}x}=\frac{2 x^{3} + x y^{2} - y^{3}}{2 x^{2} y + x y^{2}} - \frac{2 y}{x}.
$$

If the transformation $y=v(x)x$ is applied to the differential equation, what is the resulting equation?
question.:question/worked-solution:
Using the transformation $y=vx$ (where $v=v(x)$), we have

$$
\begin{aligned}\frac{\text{d}y}{\text{d}x} & =x\frac{\text{d}v}{\text{d}x}+v\frac{\text{d}}{\text{d}x}(x) \\  & =x\frac{\text{d}v}{\text{d}x}+v.\end{aligned}
$$

Substituting the above into the given differential equation, we get

$$
\begin{aligned}\frac{\text{d}y}{\text{d}x} & =\frac{2 x^{3} + x y^{2} - y^{3}}{2 x^{2} y + x y^{2}} - \frac{2 y}{x} \\ x\frac{\text{d}v}{\text{d}x}+v & =- 2 v + \frac{- v^{3} x^{3} + v^{2} x^{3} + 2 x^{3}}{v^{2} x^{3} + 2 v x^{3}} \\ x\frac{\text{d}v}{\text{d}x}+v & =- 2 v + \frac{- v^{3} + v^{2} + 2}{v^{2} + 2 v} \\ x\frac{\text{d}v}{\text{d}x} & =- 3 v + \frac{- v^{3} + v^{2} + 2}{v^{2} + 2 v} \\ x\frac{\text{d}v}{\text{d}x} & =\frac{- 4 v^{3} - 5 v^{2} + 2}{v^{2} + 2 v} \\ \left(\frac{- v^{2} - 2 v}{4 v^{3} + 5 v^{2} - 2}\right)\frac{\text{d}v}{\text{d}x} & =\frac{1}{x}.\end{aligned}
$$

question.:question/problem:
Consider the differential equation

$$
\frac{\text{d}y}{\text{d}x}=e^{\sin{\left(\frac{2 y}{x} \right)}} + \frac{2 y}{x}.
$$

If the transformation $y=v(x)x$ is applied to the differential equation, what is the resulting equation?
question.:question/worked-solution:
Using the transformation $y=vx$ (where $v=v(x)$), we have

$$
\begin{aligned}\frac{\text{d}y}{\text{d}x} & =x\frac{\text{d}v}{\text{d}x}+v\frac{\text{d}}{\text{d}x}(x) \\  & =x\frac{\text{d}v}{\text{d}x}+v.\end{aligned}
$$

Substituting the above into the given differential equation, we get

$$
\begin{aligned}\frac{\text{d}y}{\text{d}x} & =e^{\sin{\left(\frac{2 y}{x} \right)}} + \frac{2 y}{x} \\ x\frac{\text{d}v}{\text{d}x}+v & =2 v + e^{\sin{\left(2 v \right)}} \\ x\frac{\text{d}v}{\text{d}x}+v & =2 v + e^{\sin{\left(2 v \right)}} \\ x\frac{\text{d}v}{\text{d}x} & =v + e^{\sin{\left(2 v \right)}} \\ x\frac{\text{d}v}{\text{d}x} & =v + e^{\sin{\left(2 v \right)}} \\ \left(\frac{1}{v + e^{\sin{\left(2 v \right)}}}\right)\frac{\text{d}v}{\text{d}x} & =\frac{1}{x}.\end{aligned}
$$
